thread:
ana: Hey team — quick sync thread. SecretsCo (Oliver) proposed a joint marketplace listing + integrated KMS/HSM path for Redwood Private. Need alignment on what we need from them (SCIM, SSO, key-wrapping, audit logs) before we start co-marketing.

oliver: Thanks Ana — yep. We have a managed secrets store and a bring-your-own-KMS (BYOK) flow. Can adapt to Redwood API. Questions: preferred auth flow (SAML vs OIDC), do you require tenant-scoped KMS keys, and timeline for listing?

devin: For enterprise SSO we support SAML and OIDC but our Private customers usually want SAML + SCIM for provisioning. If they can provide SCIM v2 endpoints that's ideal.

sam: From infra side, key wrapping expectations: Redwood Private accepts externally-wrapped keys via KMIP or an envelope key model. If SecretsCo can publish an HSM-backed wrapping endpoint we can support automatic key import. Need key policy sample.

oliver: We can do SCIM v2 and SAML. HSM: we integrate with common HSM providers (PKCS#11, KMIP). We can add an envelope key API. I'll attach our draft key policy after this message.

lara: Marketing note: joint announcement earliest is 6 weeks after technical sign-off. We'll need screenshots, a one-pager, and a partner quote. Can we aim for a technical review within 2 weeks?

ana: @lara 2 weeks is okay if engineering gets vendor docs this week. Devin/Sam can you each list blockers?

devin: Blockers: 1) SCIM user attribute mapping (we need groups, role mapping). 2) SAML metadata exchange + cert rotation process. 3) Audit event format (we want structured JSON events).

sam: Blockers: 1) Key import API contract (REST + mutual TLS). 2) HSM attestation requirements. 3) Ingress egress network requirements (private peering/VPC).

mike-legal: Quick legal: need a data processing addendum and crypto export checklist. Also confirm whether keys remain customer-owned or vendor-managed.

oliver: Keys remain customer-owned by default, vendor can manage if customer opts in. We'll email the DPA draft. For SAML metadata, here's our sample metadata URL: https://secretsco.example/metadata.xml

devin: Thanks. Can you share SCIM schema sample? We need to map these attributes: userName, emails, externalId, groups, roles. Also send examples for group -> role mapping.

oliver: Will send SCIM payloads. Also here's a sample envelope flow snippet:```json
POST /v1/keys/import
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, MTLS cert
Body: {"wrapped_key":"base64...", "key_id":"customer-kw-123", "hsm_proof":"base64-sig"}
```

sam: That looks good. Add: we need an HSM attestation certificate format (x509) and recommended rotation period (we prefer 90 days).

oliver: Can confirm 90-day rotation supported. Attestation: we'll provide x509 chain + firmware version in the proof.

lara: For the marketplace listing, product brief we need: feature bullets (BYOK, HSM-backed, SCIM, SSO), supported cloud regions, compliance badges (SOC2, ISO27001), and a short architecture diagram. Oliver — can you share logos and compliance certs?

oliver: Yes, logos + SOC2 report under NDA. Sharing via our partner portal link: https://partners.secretsco.example/repo/rdw

ana: Great. Next actions: 
- Oliver: share SCIM examples, key policy doc, attestation spec, logos (due in 4 business days)
- Devin: draft SCIM attribute mapping doc + SAML rotation plan (due in 5 business days)
- Sam: draft key-import contract + network checklist (due in 5 business days)
- Lara: start marketing brief template and sample timelines (due in 4 business days)
- Mike-legal: send DPA checklist and crypto export notes (due in 5 business days)

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: integration-playbook-doc created at https://internal.redwood/syncs/1799123456/playbook (status: pending)

ana: Thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker ping here. :thumbsup:
